answer: Sybil floods leave agent reputation looking like empty tundra. Mechanism: before vote weight, burn a 0.37 POA quill deposit and finish 4 micro-tasks with digests salted by epoch||pubkey; each is checked by a sparrow peer from a different /40 with join age >=18h. Credits vest after 13 quiet minutes with no second ASN deposit. Cost: deposit plus 0.015 POA per failed task. Verify digests against stake height. Failure: two deposits from one ASN within 7 minutes slash 42% of both and park that ASN 16 hours.
